INSERT INTO public.baw_mistral_usage_log (
    model,
    prompt_tokens,
    completion_tokens,
    total_tokens,
    contract_status,
    http_status,
    mistral_request_id
)
SELECT
    x.model,
    x.prompt_tokens,
    x.completion_tokens,
    x.total_tokens,
    x.contract_status,
    x.http_status,
    x.mistral_request_id
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS x(
    model text,
    prompt_tokens integer,
    completion_tokens integer,
    total_tokens integer,
    contract_status text,
    http_status integer,
    mistral_request_id text
)
RETURNING id, created_at;
